required_denominator: complete annual global Boeing family/cohort departures for 2010-2025

sources.coverage_observation: Historical ADS-B/Mode-S data and public scientific datasets exist; the COVID-19 flight dataset covers flights observed by the receiver network from 2019 through 2022.
limitations: OpenSky states that it has no data before 2013 and its best coverage is Europe and the United States.
The service does not natively map observed tracks to commercial schedules, cancellations, passenger counts or equivalent schedule semantics.
Aircraft type/owner metadata are sourced from external/crowdsourced databases and are not guaranteed complete or current.
Free access to the full historical database is targeted to university-affiliated researchers, governmental organizations and aviation authorities; other access may require licensing.
sources.g2_use: coverage/sensitivity research only; not a complete compatible global annual denominator

sources.coverage_observation: Global traffic samples and flight records are publicly exposed for evaluation, including historical snapshots.
limitations: The free sample consists of complete data from the first day of each month rather than every day of the year.
Sampling one day per month cannot be scaled into a canonical annual denominator without an unvalidated extrapolation step.
Observed ADS-B coverage is not itself proof of complete global commercial-jet exposure.
sources.g2_use: reconciliation/sensitivity only; prohibited as primary annual exposure baseline

conclusion.reason: Open ADS-B sources can help cross-check traffic patterns and metadata but do not satisfy BSFM's complete, globally compatible, annual Boeing family/cohort exposure requirement without coverage and extrapolation assumptions.
